exposure: Symptomatic pregnant women with confirmed COVID-19
Symptomatic pregnant women with suspected COVID-19
outcome: Clinical and laboratory results (coagulation parameters, acute-phase reactants)
Maternal outcomes (duration of hospitalization, CT scan findings, ICU admission)
cohort: The study included 27 symptomatic pregnant women with RT-PCR-confirmed COVID-19 and 25 symptomatic pregnant women with suspected COVID-19 based on symptoms and CT findings.
finding: Early hospitalization and medical treatment can alleviate symptoms, improve the clinical course, and reduce the need for ICU in symptomatic pregnant patients with suspected or confirmed COVID-19.
mod_finding: Out of 14 deliveries, 4 patients delivered vaginally, 10 underwent a cesarean section, and 4 cesarean deliveries were indicated due to COVID-19 hypoxemia-related fetal distress.
gest_age: The gestational age of patients ranged from 6 weeks 2 days to 40 weeks 2 days.
